general_information.Description: This Course is based on the Coursera Specialization "Content Marketing," which covers both the theorical and practical lessons of content marketing. Specifically, students will be equipped with the strategic frameworks, tools, and decision-making skills needed to plan, create, optimize, and scale content in today’s digital landscape. Students will progress from foundational content strategy and audience engagement to advanced tactics for optimization, production scaling, and performance measurement. Additionally, students will explore how to align content with business goals, design content systems using pillars and topic clusters, apply modern SEO and discoverability best practices, and responsibly scale production using AI, partnerships, and repurposing strategies. Throughout the specialization, students focus on building content that is not only engaging, but discoverable, credible, and sustainable over time. They will apply the acquired knowledge and skills in completing a project to tackle a specified real-world problem.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Access the learning materials on Coursera for self-study purposes - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be eligible for the final assessment - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Access http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Explain key concepts, frameworks, and principles of content marketing, including audience analysis, buyer journey mapping, brand voice, and content strategy development.
Apply strategic frameworks (e.g., SMART goals, content calendars, and storytelling models such as CREATE) to design and implement coherent, multi-channel content marketing plans.
Analyze audience insights, content performance metrics, and KPIs to evaluate the effectiveness of content marketing campaigns and recommend data-driven improvements.
Create persuasive and engaging content (e.g., headlines, copywriting, storytelling formats) tailored to different platforms and target audiences to achieve specific marketing objectives.

Utilize AI tools and technologies in the content marketing process to enhance ideation, content production, personalization, and optimization while critically assessing their effectiveness and ethical implications.

Develop and present a comprehensive, project-based content marketing strategy that integrates course knowledge (strategy, execution, distribution, and measurement) to address a real or simulated business problem.

assessments.CLO: LO1, LO2, LO3, LO4, LO5, LO6
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Test the acquainted knowledge which students obtained from the course.
assessments.Grading Guide: (Suggestion only) Students will find an example of a web-based content marketing effort for a company, product, service or non-profit organization to present to the class. This example will include a blog and a variety of social media efforts. Photography, video, podcasts, newsletters and/or tutorials and guides may also be elements of the content marketing effort. Students will create a 15-minute presentation that will identify and assess the effectiveness of the following: The Mission Statement The Primary Goals The Core Message and Two Secondary Messages The Target Audience/Niche Customer Benefits The Unique Proposition Slogans and Taglines The Publication Schedule Students are also encouraged to complete and submit their certificate of Meta Social Media Marketing specialization by the end of the course.
